OpenCV.js 4.12.0, distributed by @techstark/opencv-js 4.12.0-release.1.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@techstark/opencv-js/-/opencv-js-4.12.0-release.1.tgz
License: Apache-2.0 (OPENCV-LICENSE.txt).
The UMD root argument is changed from `this` to `globalThis` so that the upstream
runtime can be loaded inside an ES module Web Worker. No vision code is modified.
WASM is embedded in this pinned distribution; there are no third-party requests.
